description: Add a fourth neon ZOMBIES courtyard portal next to the existing portals. Entering shows Play Zombies? YES / NO and YES navigates to the supplied Dead City preview.
notes: Uses existing courtyard portal entry and occupancy logic; existing three positions and basketball/multiplayer behaviours stay unchanged.
Adds O/Z to the existing lightweight portal label glyph atlas.
YES navigates the current view to https://preview--bcbfd409-fd14-4729-a64e-a34f33efe018.aippy.live?; NO dismisses with no navigation.
React confirmation mounts in a document.body portal above the game and pauses gameplay while open.
No multiplayer backend changes, new dependencies or asset downloads; tests/courtyard-portals.test.ts was updated in GitHub but is not necessary for the Aippy runtime import.
